whoItsFor: Developers and teams building video generation into products or pipelines, and creators who want H3 prompts written for them. The README also covers the open-weight release for those who want to fine-tune or self-host.
useCases: Generate short videos with native stereo audio from text or first/last-frame images
Combine up to 12 reference images, video clips, and audio clips in omni-reference mode
Write H3 prompts with the bundled h3-prompt-writing agent skill
